name: sample-1
description: Grayscale book scan, 4 pages, Korean prose set justified with a running header and a page number. Latin digits and names, one Hanja gloss (噴射), corner brackets 「」 and 《》. ~310 DPI source images.
notes: The PDF already carries a text layer from whatever OCR produced it, so a
default run skips every page. force_ocr is required to measure anything.
That existing layer is scored as the 'incumbent' reference, not as truth.
Page 4 ends mid-word ('맞부') at the crop edge; the ground truth keeps it
as printed rather than completing the word from the next page.
